summary: Check 60 conflates transient git-show failures with malformed sidecars and emits a false text-less WARN.
The regex flags prefixes of hyphenated-domain and uppercase-TLD emails despite its intended email exclusion.
Check 60 consumes a new tri-state read: git-show exception/non-zero rc SKIPs; only malformed/non-dict JSON WARNs. Shared dict-or-None reader byte-identical for checks 24/26/28/33/34 (0be1dad071).
